name: WPVibe

prompts.text: Which published posts have no meta description?
Draft an About page from these notes and save it as a draft.
List WooCommerce products with fewer than five items in stock.

description: WPVibe lets agents read and edit posts, media, SEO fields, WooCommerce data, and theme files on a self-hosted WordPress site that runs the WPVibe plugin. Each user signs in to their WPVibe account through the browser and authorizes their site.
